t: This 4lite single 5ft LED CCT batten provides robust and efficient lighting for various indoor settings. It features a slimline design and integrated LED technology, offering a powerful 4700 lumens output from 35W. Ideal for ancillary areas, workshops, and commercial spaces, this batten delivers versatile illumination. The colour temperature is selectable between 3000K, 4000K, and 6500K, allowing users to choose the desired white light. Installation is straightforward with movable stainless steel mounting clips, enabling flexible ceiling or wall-mounted fitting. Its durable polycarbonate body and diffuser ensure long-lasting performance, with a 50,000-hour life.
